Garfield High School Academic Decathlon Team
Consent Calendar
topics.outcome: All items under the Consent Calendar were considered routine and enacted by one motion. Items 10A–10H were approved on the Consent Calendar, with items 10F, 10G, and 10H specifically adopted as resolutions. No further action was taken beyond the routine consent motion.

topics.title: Minutes
topics.outcome: The City Council approved the minutes from the special meeting of February 18, 2026, the regular meeting of February 18, 2026, and the special community meeting of February 24, 2026 on a consent calendar.

topics.title: Professional Services Master Agreement for Sales Tax, Business License Tax, and
topics.outcome: The City Council approved the Professional Services Master Agreement for Sales Tax, Business License Tax, and Transient Occupancy Tax (TOT) Auditing Services and Utility User’s Tax Administration on the consent calendar.

topics.title: Authorize Second Amendment to Agreement No. 2244-AA with E-Plan, Inc./
topics.outcome: The City Council approved the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 2244-AA with E-Plan, Inc./e-PlanSoft on a consent calendar, extending the term for three years through June 14, 2029, and adding two additional licenses for digital plan check review software at a cost not to exceed $113,228.63.

topics.title: Data Center Ordinance - Notice of Public Hearing Date
topics.outcome: Council recommended receiving and filing the Data Center Ordinance report and taking any additional related action deemed desirable; the report was received and filed on the consent calendar.

topics.title: Award of Contract for Street Sweeping Services
Professional Municipal Clerk's Week Resolution
topics.outcome: Resolution 2026-R20 adopted declaring the week of May 3 – May 9, 2026 as Professional Municipal Clerks Week in Monterey Park.

topics.title: National Library Week Resolution
topics.outcome: Council adopted Resolution No. 2026-R21 declaring the week of April 19-25, 2026 to be National Library Week in Monterey Park and authorized related action.

topics.title: California Cities Week Resolution (As Requested by Council Member Sanchez)
topics.outcome: Approved/adopted on Consent Calendar Resolution No. 2026-R22

topics.title: New Business
topics.outcome: Council adopted Resolution No. 2026‑R23 to amend City Council protocols pursuant to Senate Bill 707, including revisions to rules of procedure, guidance on public participation guidelines, authorization for the City Manager to execute a Fourth Amendment with CivicPlus, LLC (up to $20,000 plus 5% annual adjustment), and allocation of $30,000 for audiovisual upgrades, agenda translation, outreach, website enhancements, and additional personnel costs related to SB 707 compliance.

topics.title: Amendment to City Council Protocols pursuant to Senate Bill 707 (SB 707)
topics.outcome: The City Council adopted Resolution No. 2026-R23, approving the recommended amendments to the City Council Protocols pursuant to Senate Bill 707, including revisions to rules of procedure, public participation guidelines, and authorizing the City Manager to execute a Fourth Amendment with CivicPlus, LLC up to $20,000 plus annual adjustments and allocating $30,000 for related expenses.

topics.title: Consideration and possible action to authorize the Mayor to execute the First
topics.outcome: The City Council approved the recommendation to authorize the Mayor to execute the First Amendment to Ms. Inez Alvarez’s employment agreement, with all council members voting in favor.
